ara (partnerships): Quick thread: GCP listing preflight - need billing SKU mapping + legal attach for EMEA.
nick (eng): Are we shipping a container-based GCP solution or marketplace VM? affects how billing hooks are wired.
jon (gcp-partner): Recommend container image with GKE marketplace offer. We'll need a pricing SKU and a partnerCustomerId. I can request a sandbox SKU today.
mira (legal): For EMEA, we must include localized EULA for FR/DE and VAT handling notes. Also confirm if GCP takes care of VAT collection for marketplace purchases.
billing-bot: billing docs: https://internal.redwood/billing/gcp-marketplace  pending: sku-request, tax-form
ara (partnerships): Action items: 1) jon request sandbox SKU (due EOD) 2) nick confirm artifact type + CI job (due Tue) 3) mira draft EULA addendum for FR/DE (due Wed)
nick (eng): I'll confirm container image and add a small CI step to publish manifest to gcp-staging.
jon (gcp-partner): Sandbox SKU requested. Will share partnerCustomerId when approved.
mira (legal): I'll start FR/DE EULA drafts and check with tax ops on VAT collection.
ara (partnerships): Thanks all. Ping here if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
